subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should OpenClaw add shared group pairing admission, and should pending read-only observation be part of that contract or a separate plugin/agent mode?
rationale: This changes who can authorize shared-room content, where pending approvals are stored, how owners are notified, and whether untrusted group messages may reach an agent before approval.

options.title: Design Shared Admission First
options.body: Create one cross-channel approval contract with persistence, owner notification, approve/reject authority, and explicit isolation rules before channel-specific implementation.

options.title: Ship Narrow Channel Mitigations
options.body: Let Telegram/WhatsApp warn, leave, audit, and hook work proceed while deferring owner-notified group pairing.

options.title: Keep Allowlists Only
options.body: Reject group pairing for now and document allowlists, disabled policy, mention gating, sandboxed sessions, and plugin-based observation as the supported posture.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Admission First
recommendation.body: Create one cross-channel approval contract with persistence, owner notification, approve/reject authority, and explicit isolation rules before channel-specific implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current review signal and recent history around the config/security/channel boundary touched by this decision.
